name: broker-analysis
description: Read-only financial analysis on Yahoo Finance data: risk, fundamentals, technicals, ETFs and parametric analyses with alert hooks, plus the skills that teach the agent to read every number.

interface.shortDescription: Risk, fundamentals, technicals and ETF analysis on Yahoo Finance data
interface.longDescription: A read-only MCP server for a broker's analysts: risk and return metrics, fundamental ratios and balance-sheet scores, technical indicators, ETF tracking, parametric analyses with charts and alert hooks. Every number carries its unit, formula and data window. Prototype: Yahoo Finance data through yfinance, not for production use.
